questions.prompt: Do not resist the stern leader who saved the city.
questions.answer: Nē ducī sevērō, quī urbem servāvit, repugnētis.

questions.prompt: Having heard these threats, do not abandon your comrades.
questions.answer: Hīs minīs audītīs, nē comitēs vestrōs relinquātis.

questions.prompt: Do not fear death, young men, when the fatherland calls you.
questions.answer: Nē mortem timeātis, iuvenēs, cum patria vōs vocet.

questions.prompt: Do not lay down your weapons before the walls of the enemy.
questions.answer: Nē arma vestra ante moenia hostium dēpōnātis.

questions.prompt: Do not leave that sweet woman alone in the dark house.
questions.answer: Istam dulcem fēminam sōlam in domō obscūrā nē relīquerīs.

questions.prompt: Do not trust a treacherous friend, however dear he may seem.
questions.answer: Amīcō perfidō, quamvīs cārus videātur, nē crēdiderīs.

questions.prompt: Do not, out of fear, betray the secrets of the state.
questions.answer: Nē prae metū arcāna reī pūblicae prōdiderīs.

questions.prompt: Do not despise the gifts offered by a humble farmer.
questions.answer: Dōna ab humilī agricolā oblāta nē contempserīs.

questions.prompt: Let not the impious dare to appease the angry gods.
questions.answer: Impiī nē īrātōs plācāre audeant deōs.

questions.prompt: Let no one, deceived by hope, neglect his duty.
questions.answer: Nē quis, spē dēceptus, officium suum neglegat.

questions.prompt: Let not the tyrant, drunk with power, oppress the citizens.
questions.answer: Nē tyrannus, potestāte ēbrius, cīvēs opprimat.

questions.prompt: Let not the soldiers, wearied by the long march, lay down their arms.
questions.answer: Nē mīlitēs, longō itinere fessī, arma dēpōnant.

questions.prompt: Do not touch the sacred altars with unclean hands.
questions.answer: Nōlī ārās sacrās manibus impūrīs tangere.

questions.prompt: Do not lie to the judge, lest you be condemned.
questions.answer: Nōlī iūdicī mentīrī, nē damnēris.

questions.prompt: Do not forget the friends who helped you in danger.
questions.answer: Nōlīte amīcōs, quī vōs in perīculō adiūvērunt, oblīvīscī.

questions.prompt: Do not despise those weakened by a long illness.
questions.answer: Nōlīte eōs longō morbō tenuātōs contemnere.

questions.prompt: Take care not to wound the throat of the sacrificial victim.
questions.answer: Cavē nē victimae iugulum vulnerēs.

questions.prompt: Beware of trusting the words of a cruel king.
questions.answer: Cavē verbīs rēgis inhūmānī crēdās.

questions.prompt: Take care lest, blinded by anger, you disturb the sacred rites.
questions.answer: Cavē nē, īrā caecātus, sacra perturbēs.

questions.prompt: Beware, helmsman, of despising the raging sea.
questions.answer: Cavē, gubernātor, mare saeviēns contemnās.

questions.prompt: Do not pity the man who betrayed his fatherland.
questions.answer: Cavē tē eius misereat, quī patriam prōdidit.

questions.prompt: Do not forgive the crime committed against the innocent.
questions.answer: Cavē scelerī in innocentēs commissō ignōscās.

questions.prompt: Having lost hope, do not cast yourself down from the high wall.
questions.answer: Spē āmissā, nē tē dē altō mūrō dēiēcerīs.

questions.prompt: Let not the guest, kindly received, betray his host.
questions.answer: Nē hospes, benignē receptus, hospitem prōdat.
